programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game $100/$200 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 1
programme.desc: WPT has invited a star-studded lineup to this high-stakes cash game showdown.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game $100/$200 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 1

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game $100/$200 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 2
programme.desc: The Godfather of Poker, Doyle Brunson, is once again proving why he is considered one of the best to ever play the game.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game $100/$200 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 2

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game $100/$200 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 3
programme.desc: The man with the most WPT titles all-time, Darren Elias is putting his table mates to the test on this episode of WPT's high-stakes cash game.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game $100/$200 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 3

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game $100/$200 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 4
programme.desc: World-famous DJ Steve Aoki has joined the table in place of Brad Owen and Steve is more than ready to gamble.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game $100/$200 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 4

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game $100/$200 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 5
programme.desc: The high-stakes action is heating up at this table full of stars on and off the felt.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game $100/$200 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 5

programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Cash Game $100/$200 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 6
programme.desc: This episode of WPT high stakes cash has all of the entertainment that you would expect from such a high-profile cast that includes the likes of Maria Ho, Steve Aoki, Darren Elias, Andrew Neeme, Ema Zajmovic, and Bryan Ercolano.
programme.sub-title: WPT Cash Game $100/$200 No Limit Holdem 2022 - Part 6

programme.desc: Six talented ClubWPT players continue to battle at the final table with their eye on the first-place prize of $50,000.

programme.title: Andromeda: Djævelen tager det længste strå
programme.desc: Dylan og Rev Bem hjælper et fredeligt samfund med at stå op mod deres potentielle slavehandlere.

programme.title: Andromeda: Honningtilbuddet
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at skabe fred mellem to forskellige nietzscheanske stoltheder ved at eskortere prinsessen fra det ene sted til hendes arrangerede ægteskab med prinsen fra det andet sted.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stjernekrydsede
programme.desc: Rommies avatar bliver forelsket i det, der viser sig at være avataren af et krigsskib ved navn Gabriel. Gabriel forsøger at inficere Rommie med en virus, der sender sine planer til krigsskibet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det er et dejligt lys
programme.desc: Beka tager Andromeda med til Tarn-Vedra, men længere tid i slipstrømmen giver bivirkninger. For at bekæmpe dem begynder Beka at tage Flash og bliver snart afhængig.

programme.title: Andromeda: Endelig er tiden kommet
programme.desc: En gammel erindring fra Andromeda aktiveres ved et uheld, hvilket sender hende på en mission og efterlader Dylan og besætningen ude af stand til at tilsidesætte kommandoen

programme.title: Andromeda: Det voksende kredsløb
programme.desc: Dylan og Rommie skal redde Tyr, Harper og Rev fra et Magog-verdenskib.

programme.title: Andromeda: Exitstrategier
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka, Rev og Tyr styrter ned efter at være undsluppet en bande nietzscheanere, men står snart over for en ny trussel: Rev's behov for at spise.

programme.title: Andromeda: Et hjerte for falskhed indrammet
programme.desc: Besætningen skal stjæle en juvel, som er centrum for en fejde mellem en driftsejer og Than. Beka falder for en sikkerhedschef, som tidligere var tyv.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ubarmhjertig som solen
programme.desc: Andromeda besvarer et nødopkald, da et fragtskib bliver angrebet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Sidste udkald ved den ødelagte hammer
programme.desc: Besætningen leder efter en længe forsvundet leder af Commonwealth, som er gået i skjul.
programme.sub-title: Sidste udkald ved den ødelagte hammer

programme.title: Andromeda: Alt for menneskeligt
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka og Trance tager med Rommie for at finde ud af noget om et våben, der udvikles på en planet, som ikke har tillid til AI.

programme.title: Andromeda: Una Salus Victus
programme.desc: Andromeda har til opgave at eskortere medicinske skibe sikkert gennem Drago-Kazov-rummet

programme.title: Andromeda: Hjemmefester
programme.desc: En planet med overlevende fra Commonwealth, som ledes af Dylans tidligere forlovede, bliver inviteret til at slutte sig til det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ind i labyrinten
programme.desc: En agent fra Abyss forsøger at lokke Harper til at slutte sig til Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda: Prinsen
programme.desc: Da de redder en ung prins fra et oprør, der dræber resten af hans familie, bliver Dylan og Tyr bedt om at blive hans rådgivere.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bunker Hill
programme.desc: Dylan og hans nye flåde fra Commonwealth tager kampen op mod Drago-Kazov-flåden, men finder den meget større end forventet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ouroboros
programme.desc: Magog-æggene i Harper er begyndt at klække, så holdet bygger en Tesseract-maskine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lava og raketter
programme.desc: Dylan overtager en turistbåd i et forsøg på at undslippe lejesoldaterne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Alle mine synder skal huskes
programme.desc: En identifikation af et lig går galt, da det viser sig, at Bekas tidligere besætningsmedlem ikke er død.

programme.title: Andromeda: Enfluernes dans
programme.desc: Andromeda redder døende mennesker fra en drivkraft, men de bliver snart til zombier, der styres af et hive-mind.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himlen er der nu tre
programme.desc: Skaberens motor er i stand til at omskrive universet efter ejerens ønsker. Dylan, Beka og Trance må få fat i den, før nogen med mørke planer får fat i den.
programme.sub-title: I himlen er der nu tre

programme.title: Forensic Files: Runaway Love
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother, Barbara Mullenix, in 2006. She allegedly packed her mother's bloodied corpse in a cardboard box before dumping it in California's Newport Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: On May 20, 2001, Carrie Nelson was beaten to death while working alone in a park office. The case went unsolved for six years. Finally, police found a match with DNA samples gathered from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Little Secret
programme.desc: Police get a clue about a couple who disappeared on Memorial Day weekend during an in-progress robbery. The evidence found solves a brutal crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lights Out
programme.desc: In this episode, the decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purebread Murder
programme.desc: In 2000, Christina Sanoubane was murdered in her Cedar Rapids apartment after moving away from her abusive boyfriend. There are clues at the scene: bloody footprints and DNA from the victim's rape kit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: In 2006, Darlene VanderGiesen received threatening emails and then disappeared. Tracking the source of the emails led police to the home of Daphne Wright, where they believe a murder was committed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hell's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Kristine Fitzhugh failed to show up for her music class, her husband found her dead at the bottom of the stairs of their Palo Alto home. Further investigation reveals evidence of murder in the kitchen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: In 1999, Susan Fassett was gunned down as she left her church choir practice in Poughkeepsie, NY. After clearing her husband, police turned their attention to Fred Andros, with whom Susan had an affair.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Squire's Riches
programme.desc: Responding to a 2008 garage fire, Illinois emergency response discovered a man crushed beneath a truck.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home of the Brave
programme.desc: In 2007, the Florida mobile home of Effie and Michael Ratley catches fire. Michael heroically rescues his wife and infant son. A month later, his wife is found beaten to death in a bedroom of his parents' home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freeze Framed
programme.desc: In 2005, David Castor suffered a slow, agonizing death over a period of days. His wife maintained it was suicide, even though it was done with antifreeze.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Touch of Evil
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the media dubbed Richard Rogers the "Last Call Killer" because he targeted men in gay bars who were obviously intoxicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Textbook Murder
programme.desc: Avis Banks and her unborn child were brutally murdered. The body was discovered by her fiancé, Keyon Pittman. When police learned that Pittman was having affairs with other women, he became the prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Filtered Out
programme.desc: In 2000, teenager Tara Munsey went missing after a work shift at a Virginia restaurant. Did she run away, or was she the victim of foul play?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Logged
programme.desc: In 1989, the dead bodies of Joan Rogers and her two teenage daughters were found floating in Tampa Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Social Circle
programme.desc: In 2003, Tiffany Rowell and three of her friends were brutally murdered in affluent Clear Lake, Texas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Low Maintenance
programme.desc: In 2008, college co-ed Jenna Verhaalen was found dead in her Bryan, Texas apartment. Petechial hemorrhages in her eyes indicated that she was strangled.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fate Date
programme.desc: In 2004, Rebecca Barney and her soon-to-be ex-husband Fred were found shot to death in their Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, which had been set on fire.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of a Killer
programme.desc: In 2003, Kathy Lorick was murdered on a Concord, California jogging trail while talking to her husband on her mobile phone.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gone Ballistic
programme.desc: In 2008, the body of Colorado real estate developer Alan Helmick was found by his wife, Miriam, who then became the prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeing Red
programme.desc: In 2005, the body of young mother Summer Baldwin was found in a suitcase in a Texas landfill.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skeleton Key
programme.desc: In 2004, nursing student Tamika Huston went missing from her Spartanburg, South Carolina home. A tip led detectives to her car, where they found an unknown house key that could help solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Funeral Services
programme.desc: In 2002, funeral director Lonnie Turner, Sr. was found shot to death. His son Lonnie Jr. became the prime suspect, particularly after it was discovered that the murder was committed with his gun. However, he had an alibi for the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Expert Witness
programme.desc: In 1993, young mother Tammy Tatum was sexually assaulted and murdered in her Longmont, Colorado apartment. Police initially suspected her estranged husband, but did not have enough evidence to charge him and the case went cold.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Critical Evidence
programme.desc: To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.desc: Having never been to these amazing Caribbean jewels, I can now see what everyone has raved about the last several years.

programme.desc: The murder of a popular teen at a crowded house party sends Kenda down a winding road paved with lies, misdirection, and innuendo.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bring My Baby Home
programme.desc: A four-week-old girl is kidnapped, leaving her mother in anguish and police scrambling to find her. Joe Kenda and Robert Sapp fear she’s been sold on the black market… or worse.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: How to Colonize the Stars: The Challenge of Interstellar Flight
programme.desc: Leading physicists and engineers in the field of interstellar travel discuss some of the deep issues we face when considering the problem of sending spacecraft to other stars. Will mankind ever truly become a space fairing civilization?

programme.desc: Heidi og Lauren skændes endnu engang offentligt, hvilket får Heidi til at undskylde for alt det, der er sket. Og der er problemer i Audrina og Justins forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: With This Ring...
programme.desc: Lauren leger Kirsten Giftekniv, da Whitney skal ud på sin første date med deres personlige træner. Og Spencer modsætter sig Heidis ønsker om et eventyrbryllup.

programme.title: The Hills: A Night At The Opera
programme.desc: Audrina ser Justin kysse med en anden pige, hvilket fører til endnu et kæmpeskænderi. Heidi er chokeret, da Stephanie skændes med Lauren og Brody på en natklub.

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player
programme.desc: Lauren tror, at Brody måske er for meget playboy for hende. Spencers søster fortæller hende, at Heidi er i tvivl om deres bryllup.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får en god nyhed til Teen Vogue og Heidi har brug for noget tid væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer endelig af sted til Paris, men turen bliver næsten ødelagt da hun finder ud af, at Brody har fundet en anden. Spencer følger Heidi til Colorado for at prøve at vinde hende tilbage, men hans plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney må vælge mellem Teen Vogue og risikoen forbundet med at gå efter en ny karriere. Lauren og Brody skændes over hans nye kæreste og Heidi vænner sig til livet uden Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en uventet ven, da Spencers søster, Stephanie, går til de samme timer som hende. Whitney tror, at hendes nye job vil opfylde alle hendes drømme.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: Da Lauren inviterer Stephanie til hendes fødselsdag, får det Heidi og Spencer til at tvivle på Stephanies loyalitet. Spencer forsøger at vinde Heidi tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...
programme.desc: Heidi prøver at vinde Audrinas venskab tilbage, men Lauren tvivler på Heidis motiver. Whitney er ved at vænne sig til sit nye job, men savner stadig at arbejde sammen med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Heidi elsker at være single, men da hun ser Spencer sammen med andre piger bliver hun jaloux. Whitney beder om Laurens hjælp til modeugen i LA.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate
programme.desc: Med Spencer ude af billedet, gør Heidi et sidste forsøg på at blive gode venner med Lauren igen. Da Audrina begynder at tilbringe mere tid med Heidi og Justin, overvejer Lauren, om de bør blive ved med at bo sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: Gammel kærlighed blusser op da Stephen Coletti dukker op i Laurens liv igen. Heidi prøver at sørge for, at Stephanie ikke kommer til Laurens housewarming.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren har svært ved at vælge side, da problemerne mellem Lo og Audrina eskalerer. Og Heidi tager et job, der vil tage hende til Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit føler Audrina sig lukket ude af Laurens venskab med Lo, og hun overvejer at flytte ud. Lauren gør et sidste forsøg på at blive god venner med Audrina, men måske er det for sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: Da sæson fire starter er situationen mellem Audrina og Lo anspændt. Lauren forsøger at gøre et godt indtryk på en ny fyr, og et besøg fra Heidis søster Holly truer Spencer og Heidis forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie bliver uvenner med sin bror og hans ven da Lauren møder Spencer på sin fødselsdag. Kelly Cutrone fyrer en fra People's Revolution og Whitney overtager stillingen. Laurens forhold til Doug udvikler sig lidt for hurtigt.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren indser at den kemi, hun havde med Doug på studiet ikke længere er der. Whitney er nervøs for at tage til New York, men en date med en model gør hende gladere. Til trods for forsoningsgestusen vil Spencer bryde helt med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En vild tur til Las Vegas går galt, da Audrina ignorerer Lauren. Brody nævner Stephanies fortid, og drengene ryger i brummen. Heidis søster Holly flytter ind, men det er intet Spencer hellere vil end at smide hende ud.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kæmper for at redde deres venskab, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fået nok af Heidis søster Holly og tager sagen i egne hænder. Og Brody og Doug forlader fængslet med nye historier.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis søster Holly tager kontakt med Lauren, noget som tvinger både Lauren og Heidi til at revurdere hvad der er sket med dere venskab.. Audrina og Justins forhold bliver sat på prøve, da hun arbejder på en event for Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: Da Lauren tager på ferie med familien, går alting galt i Los Angeles. Stephanie dater Doug bag Laurens rygg, og Audrina og Heidi bliver venner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sandheden om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer frem, da de alle mødes til Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøg til LA og ryger ud i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi, hvor hun beklager og indser, at der kun er én ting, som forhindrer dem i at blive venner igen. Audrina starter med at date en ny fyr for at gøre Justin jaloux, men hendes plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møder sin gamle flamme Corey igen og jonglerer pludselig to fyre. Spencer tvinger Heidi til at smide sin søster Holly ud af lejligheden.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina rejser til Cabo til Brody fødselsdag, men da Justin bliver jaloux på Audrinas nye forhold, udvikler festen sig til en slåskamp. Spencer ydmyger Stephanie da hun finder ud af, at hendes nye kæreste er ven med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at skabe fred mellem Brody og Stephanie. Audrina vil få tingene til at fungere med Corey, men Justin vil ikke give slip på hende. Stephanie tvivler på sin nye kæreste, da han bryder sit løfte om at konfrontere Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina får sit eget sted, og håber, at Justin vil flytte ind hos hende, men alle frygter, at hun flytter af den forkerte grund. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med arbejdet og bliver taget i at have det lidt for sjovt.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney tager til New York i forventning om at møde Alex igen, men en ny fyr ved navn Jay fanger hendes opmærksomhed. Heidi er ulykkelig efter fyringen, men da Spencer taler med Brent for at skaffe hende jobbet tilbage, forværrer han situationen.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren lader Heidis søster overnatte. Justin inviterer Audrina med på en romantisk weekend, og Heidis frustration med Spencer vokser, da hun må tigge for at få sit job tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rygte, hun hører: at Lauren har kysset med Justin. I mellemtiden prøver Holly at få Heidi væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina forsøger at redde sit venskab med Lauren efter at have anklaget hende for at have kysset med Justin. Spencer og Stephanie besøger deres bedstemore, som er træt af, at de skændes.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney bliver tilbudt en chance for a score sit drømmejob NYC og håber at se Jay der. Lauren bliver nostalgisk, da hendes forældre sælger huset i Laguna Beach, og Stephanie går til Spencer for at få hjælp med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer og Heidi ignorerer deres bekymrede familier og stikker af til Mexico for at blive gift. Whitney går efter drømmejobbet i New York City, og siger farvel til Lauren og sit liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi mødes og husker, hvorfor de plejede at være venner. Spencer og Heidi er lige blevet gift, da Heidis mor kommer til byen. Justin chokerer Audrina, da han tager hende med til Palm Springs til en overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: Da Heidi kommer uanmeldt til Laurens fødselsdagsfest, græder de to gamle venner over deres ødelagte venskab. Spencer kommer op at slås, da Cameron beskylder ham for at samle en bartender op.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers flirtende opførsel får Heidi til at tage hjem til Colorado, hvor hun møder en gammel kæreste. Lauren skælder Stephanie ud for at have inviteret Heidi til festen. Spencer ender en lang stilhed med Brody.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Calum's Choice
programme.desc: Calumm skal sende en af sine ekser hjem. Georgia bliver følelsesladet med Ashley, Michael og Ellie kommer tættere på hinanden og der er en surprise-kendis i horisonten.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Miles and the Mob Wife
programme.desc: Miles, den nye kendis, gør et stort indtryk på Marissa. David får skældud og piger skal træffe en vigtig beslutning.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: As One Door Closes Another One Opens
programme.desc: En af drengene bliver sendt hjem, og det efterlader pigerne med tårer i øjnene. Det bliver for meget for en af de originale 8, og Sophie har muligvis mødt sin drømmemand. Får David en chance til?
programme.sub-title: As One Door Closes Another One Opens

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Mob Wife Goes In
programme.desc: Georgia og Miles kommer tættere på hinanden, men ender det i tårer? Marissa bliver presset til sin 'mafiakone'-grænse og Joey og Lorena tager ned på stranden til den sidste ankomst!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Finale
programme.desc: Joey får sit livs chok, da en eks gør en spektakulær entré til den store finale, og Georgia bliver følelsesladet, men får hun sin lykkelige slutning med de andre par?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Zahida Wages War
programme.desc: Otte sexede singler opdager, at deres drøm om sommerkærlighed bliver et mareridt, når flere ekser end nogensinder kommer for at skabe kaos. Zahida kæmper med Maisie om Sean, men når den første eks kommer, bliver det et værre blodbad.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: A Sea Of Tears
programme.desc: Det syder i villaen, når ikke bare en, men tre ekser ankommer og skaber kaos for turtelduerne Ross og Harriette. Zahidas eks Joe mister kontrollen, og Alex truer med at drukne sig i tårer.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Love Triangle
programme.desc: Singlernes elendighed fortsætter, da Sean springer fra Zahida til Zaralena, og Harriettes kærlighedstrekant bliver værre. Maisie vil have, der skal ske noget, og Aaron fra 'Geordie Shore' gør en storslået entré, men hvem af ekserne er hans?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Nicole's Nightmare
programme.desc: Spændingerne i villaen når kogepunktet, da Zaralena får Zahidas vrede at føle. Den nye eks får fyrene til at føre sig territorialt. Josh har et godt øje til Nicole, men slutter det, da hun opdager en knusende hemmelighed?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Blonde Bombshell
programme.desc: Adam afslører sine følelser for Nicole, og Jack og Josh vil have nyt blod i villaen. Zaralena og Aaron kommer tættere på hinanden, og Ross og Harriette tilbringer natten i loftslejligheden. Men en ny eks kan ødelægge det for alle.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Heartache
programme.desc: Terrortabletten gør livet surt for Becca. Harriettes hjertesorg bliver værre, og Zaralenas elendighed fortsætter, men det er den nyeste eks, der truer med at skabe det værste kaos.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Truth Comes Out
programme.desc: Ankomsten af endnu en eks fører til et blodbad i villaen. Nicole må høre sandheden om Jacques Fraser, mens Ross og Harriette skændes igen. Og Zaralena tager en stor beslutning.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Jacques Comeuppance
programme.desc: Jacques Fraser får omsider sin straf. Det nyeste ekser stormer stranden og villaen, skaber splid mellem Sean og Zahida og skaber kaos for resten.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Aaron Moves On
programme.desc: Der kommer to nye ekser, til Aarons glæde og Beccas fortvivlelse. Maisie når bunden, Harriette får et sammenbrud og Sean og Jack kommer ryger i totterne på hinanden.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Terrortabletten holder et stort græsk bryllup for Sean og Zahida, men da den sidste eks kommer, bliver festen kaotisk. Harriette får en chokerende besked af Ross.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Welcome to Ex on the Beach
programme.desc: 10 stjerner fra reality-tv og sociale medier tror, at de er på en sexet tropeferie, men paradiset forvandles til et mareridt, når deres ekser dukker op på stranden. Vil det tænde gamle flammer eller åbne gamle sår?

programme.desc: En ny eks kommer med en hemmelighed, der skaber skandale i hele huset. Par, og tidligere par, udsættes for deres værste mareridt, da de introduceres for Hemmelighedshullet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US
programme.desc: Huset må beslutte, hvem der har det sværest, når en single er i klemme mellem to ekser og en anden udsættes for sin værste eks. En sexet date ender i kaos.

programme.desc: Angela går til sin eks, da hun hører, hvad der skete mellem hendes nuværende fyr og en anden. De to kvinder, der kæmper om Chase, kæmper pludselig om den nye fyr.

programme.desc: Kareem og Alexis presses til bristepunktet, da Alivia og Keith udforsker, om de er et perfekt par. Ekser kommer med afsløringer, inklusive en eks, der allerede ved besked.

programme.desc: Audrey bliver paranoid, da hun ser Michael skabe kontakt til Geles. Malcolm får ballade, fordi han er en player, og huset begynder at udforske nye forbindelser.

programme.desc: Jalousi kommer i centrum til en vild Mardi Gras-fest. Geles bliver fjende nummer et, da hun bager på flere fyre i huset. Dimitri provokerer Jada.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love by the Numbers
programme.desc: Tyler vil gerne ud af venneboblen med Nicole. Shad viser nogle følelser. Der er knuste hjerter og jalousi i huset, og de beder Keith om at finde en vinderstrategi.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Den sidste parceremoni nærmer sig hastigt, så huset er desperat for at få de rigtige par ind i sandhedsbåsen og finde de 11 rigtige par. Keith og Alexis presser hinanden lige til bristepunktet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 2

programme.title: Are You The One?: With Frenemies Like These...
programme.desc: Zak udforsker sine muligheder, mens kvinderne slås om hans opmærksomhed. Kenya og Jasmine bliver officielt fjender.

programme.sub-title: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tracurricular Activities
programme.desc: Huset bliver rystet, da deres ekser dukker op for at få noget kvalitetstid. Bølgerne går højt, når en eks truer med at splitte et stærkt par ad. Zak er splittet mellem Bria og Morgan.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Spilling The Tea
programme.desc: Kwasi starter drama, da han afslører, hvad Tevin og Jasmine gjorde natten før. Bria bliver sur over Morgan og Zaks forhold. Huset tager nogle risikable parvalg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: He Loves Me Not

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beast Mode
programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt mellem Cam og Kwasi, da Kwasi lægger an på Kayla. Asia eksploderer, da hun tror, at nogle folk i huset er falske. Zak må træffe et valg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I Want You To Want Me
programme.desc: Nutsa er vild med Brett, men det får konsekvenser for hele huset, at Brett ikke kan glemme Cali. Moe bliver presset til at spille spillet, og Lewis afslører sine sande følelser for Asia.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Want Me

programme.title: Are You The One?: Master Plan
programme.desc: Brias besættelse af Zak truer husets evne til at spille spillet. Cali finder på en plan, der skal afsløre, hvilke magtpar, der er perfekte sammen, og hvem der ikke er.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time
programme.desc: Til en vild fest gør tvivlsom opførsel bedste venner til fjender. Tevin og Kenya gør sig klar til at få opklaret deres skæbne. Moe bliver presset til at tage sig sammen.
programme.sub-title: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time

programme.title: Are You The One?: Caught On Kiss Cam
programme.desc: Kwasi og Jasmines forhold bliver bragt i fare, når en velkendt fjende komme lidt for tæt på. Magtpar prøver at skabe nye forbindelser.

programme.desc: Oplev de dramatiske øjeblikke, når de unge mødre tackler hverdagens udfordringer eller oplever uforglemmelige øjeblikke. Det er non-stop drama hele dagen, hver dag.

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
programme.sub-title: Now You See Me, Now I Don't

programme.title: Awkward: The Dis-Engagement Dinner
programme.desc: Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: The Graduates
programme.desc: Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
programme.desc: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.
programme.sub-title: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Lars and The Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars Lindstrom er en elskelig indadvendt mand, hvis emotionelle bagage har afholdt ham fra at udforske livet. Efter flere års ensomhed inviterer han Bianca, en ven han har mødt på internettet. Han introducerer Bianca for sin bror, Gus og hans kone, Karen.

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: Leigh Anns (Katie Holmes) drømme om et legat ødelægges, da hendes lærer, fru Tingle, med urette beskylder hende for at snyde. Da hun er desperat for at bevise sin uskyld, lægger Leigh Ann planer, der skal lære fru Tingle en lektie.

programme.title: JFK
programme.desc: Da distriktsanklager Jim Garrison (Kevin Costner) nærlæser rapporten om mordet på præsident Kennedy, får han mistanke om, at der ligger mere bag end det, der er offentligt kendt.

programme.title: The Last Face
programme.desc: Filmen følger Wren (Charlie Theron), som er direktør for en nødhjælpsorganisation i Afrika og sammen med lægen Miguel Leon (Javier Bardem) forsøger at redde så mange som muligt under en politisk revolution.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en rigtig filmnørd, som ejer en lille videobutik. Når han ikke sidder fastklistret foran fjernsynet og en eller anden film noir, diskuterer han film med sine to medarbejdere, supernørden Lucien og den noget stabilere Jonathan.

programme.title: Win A Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Rosaleee en benovet pige fra en lille by vinder en date med den sexede Hollywood-skuespiller Tad Hamilton. Og mens Rosalees drøm måske er gået i opfyldelse, betyder det komplet kaos for hendes bedste ven Pete.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Efter Cady har boet i Afrika, aner hun intet om, hvor 'vilde' ting kan blive i civilisationen, indtil hun møder den ondeste art 'Queen Bee', der på denne skole er den kølige og kalkulerende Regina George.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Chers verden går op i limningen med den pludselige tilstedeværelse af to lækre fyre i hendes liv: en sexet, ny klassekammerat og hendes kedelige men søde eks-stedbror. Hun lærer nu, at når det handler om kærlighed, så ved hun ingenting.

programme.title: Bare Juliet
programme.desc: Annie (Rose Byrne) er kørt træt i sit parforhold med Duncan (Chris O'Dowd), der er kæmpefan af musikeren Tucker Crowe (Ethan Hawke). Da en demoversion af Tuckers gamle hit LP dukker op, bliver det starten på et nyt møde med den flyvske kunstner.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Advokat MattMurdock er blind, men hans resterende fire sanser er overmenneskelige skarpe. Om dagen repræsenterer Murdock de undertrykte, men om natten er han.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Da en klog sort hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles bliver transporteret tilbage til middelalderens England, leder han omstyrtelsen af en ond konge og vinder en protofeministisk kvindes hjerte.

programme.title: Lionheart
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme spiller Lyon Gaultier, som deserterer fra den franske Fremmedlegion for at hjælpe sin myrdede brors familie i USA. Men at komme gennem USA uden penge på lommen viser sig at være svært.

programme.title: Pound Of Flesh
programme.desc: POUND OF FLESH er hæsblæsende action med legenden Jean-Claude Van Damme i hovedrollen. Deacon er en tidligere undercover-agent, som får stjålet sin nyre af nogle organtyve, natten før han har planlagt at donere den til sin døende niece.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: Humpday
programme.desc: Det har gået ti år siden Ben og Andrew var skolens 'bad boys' i college. Ben er faldet til ro og har skaffet sig arbejde, kone og villa. Andrew har valgt at gå en anden vej som kringvandrende kunstner. Når Andrew uventet dukker op hos Ben ...

programme.title: Airplane Mode
programme.desc: Et fly fyldt med sexgale unge er på vej til Australien for at deltage i et socialt mediekonvent i Sydney. Men spørgsmålet er, om nogen vil overleve flugten fra helvede.

programme.title: Nana's Secret Recipe
programme.desc: Efter at have mistet deres pensionsopsparing i en Ponzi-svindel, åbner fem kvinder et bageri. En magisk opskrift kan redde dem, men når narkohandleren opdager ingredienserne, opstår problemer.

programme.title: Plus One
programme.desc: For at overleve sommerens mange bryllupper aftaler de mangeårige venner, singlerne Ben og Alice, at være hinandens ledsagere til alle de bryllupper, de er inviteret til. Filmen vandt publikumsprisen på Tribeca Film Festival.

programme.title: Vampire In Brooklyn
programme.desc: Som vampyren Maximillian er den populære stjerne den mest djævelske, betagende og bestemt uddøde fyr i ghettoen.

programme.title: Patrick
programme.desc: Sarah Francis er en ung kvinde, hvis liv er noget værre rod. Det sidste, hun har brug for, er en anden, hun skal tage sig af. Men uanset om hun kan lide det eller ej, har hendes bedstemor ladet sin meget forkælede hund, mopsen Patrick, gå i arv til hende.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en rigtig filmnørd, som ejer en lille videobutik. Når han ikke sidder fastklistret foran fjernsynet og en eller anden film noir, diskuterer han film med sine to medarbejdere, supernørden Lucien og den noget stabilere Jonathan.

programme.title: Dating Amber
programme.desc: Teenagerne Eddie og Amber vokser op i en lille irsk by i løbet af 1990'erne. Alle har mistanke om at de er homoseksuelle, og hver dag er en kamp. De mødes og lader som om og indser at et opdigtet forhold kan være mindst lige så kompliceret som et rigtigt.

programme.title: Mit hjem i Hampstead
programme.desc: 'Mit hjem i Hampstead' er en sjov og livsbekræftende feelgood-film om, at kærligheden findes de mest uventede steder og beviser én gang for alle, at alder ikke er en hindring for at starte helt forfra.

programme.title: About Hope
programme.desc: Thomas McKenzie har ledt efter den perfekte kvinde i hele sit liv. Da han møder to kvinder, som vækker hans interesse, går det op for ham, at den kærlighed, vi søger, ikke altid er den kærlighed, vi har brug for.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Murder Of Stephen Cameron

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A Texas judge who liked to throw the book at drug dealers is murdered, and the hitman suspected of doing the job is Charles Harrelson, father of actor Woody Harrelson. Narrated by Paul Winfield.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Federal Express airline pilots Holly and Mike Mullins seemed to be flying high when they first married. But as they soon learned, marriage between pilots has its ups and downs.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A sex and murder-for-hire scandal lands televangelist George Crossley in jail. Paul Winfield narrates.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: After All These Years
programme.desc: It's been three years since Zaheer poisoned Korra and the members of Team Avatar have moved on with their lives; Kai and Opal help a struggling Earth Kingdom town.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Korra Alone
programme.desc: Korra's three-year journey of healing takes her to unexpected places.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Coronation
programme.desc: Prince Wu's big day is ruined by Kuvira; Korra thinks she may have found the key to a full recovery.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Calling
programme.desc: Tenzin tasks Jinora, Ikki, and Meelo with a mission of the utmost importance - to find Korra.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Kuvira threatens Zaofu; Bolin is caught in the middle of the bad blood between Su Beifong and Kuvira.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Battle of Zaofu
programme.desc: Korra returns to her role as the Avatar, but is she really ready for action? Bolin and Varrick break from Kuvira's army.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Reunion
programme.desc: Korra returns to Republic City and Team Avatar faces their first mission together in three years when Prince Wu goes missing; Bolin and Varrick are on the lam.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Remembrances
programme.desc: A look back at Team Avatar's journey; Varrick tells the story of the greatest move ever made.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Beyond the Wilds
programme.desc: The spirit vines in Republic City start abducting people and it's up to Korra to figure out why.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Operation Beifong
programme.desc: Bolin helps Opal and Lin save the Beifongs from Kuvira; Korra visits the Spirit World looking for help.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Kuvira's Gambit
programme.desc: Korra and Team Avatar try to stop Kuvira from moving against Republic City; Kuvira unveils a deadly new weapon.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Day of the Colossus
programme.desc: Team Avatar clashes with Kuvira on the streets of Republic City; Pema and Prince Wu help evacuate innocent citizens.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Last Stand
programme.desc: The fate of the Earth Kingdom and the Avatar's life is at stake, when Korra comes face to face with Kuvira.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boy in the Iceberg
programme.desc: When a young waterbender, named Katara, and her brother, Sokka, discover a giant iceberg while fishing for food around their homestead at the South Pole, they discover that there is a boy, named Aang, inside.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar Returns
programme.desc: After Aang accidentally sets off a Fire Nation trap, he is banished from the South Pole. Soon after Prince Zuko attacks the Southern Water Tribe seeking to capture the Avatar. Aang returns and surrenders to save the Water Tribe.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Southern Air Temple
programme.desc: Aang is eager to take Sokka and Katara to the Air Temple where he was raised. But upon arrival, it becomes apparent that the temple is not at all how Aang remembers it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Warriors of Kyoshi
programme.desc: As one of Aang's little detours, the group heads toward the island of Kyoshi. But soon they learn that the townspeople don't trust foreigners at all; however, when Aang proves to them that he is the Avatar they are treated as guests of honor.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The King of Omashu
programme.desc: Aang takes Katara and Sokka back to a favorite place he used to go to when he was younger, the Earth Kingdom City of Omashu. But when they break the law they are taken to the King to get their punishment.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Imprisoned
programme.desc: The kids come to an Earth Nation town which is occupied by the Fire Nation. But will Katara's attempts to inspire the oppressed people help them or hurt them?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Winter Solstice Part 1: The Spirit World
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka arrive at a town being terrorized by a mysterious force from the spirit world. Aang doesn't know how to help these people, and realizes he has much to learn about being the Avatar.
programme.sub-title: Winter Solstice Part 1: The Spirit World

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Winter Solstice Part 2: Avatar Roku
programme.desc: During the winter solstice, Aang must reach a Fire Nation temple while dodging Prince Zuko, Commander Zhao, and the Fire Sages who guard it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Scroll
programme.desc: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, she is desperate to improve her abilities.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Jet
programme.desc: While traveling towards the North Pole, the group almost gets captured by the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Great Divide
programme.desc: When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Storm
programme.desc: A powerful storm brings up painful memories of the past - and puts everyone in jeopardy in the present.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Blue Spirit
programme.desc: After Sokka and Katara get sick due to being in the storm, Aang seeks out a cure and discovers he needs some frozen frogs in order to get them cured.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Fortuneteller
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives - but they are so reliant that they are blind to the immanent danger they are all in.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bato of the Water Tribe
programme.desc: Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Deserter
programme.desc: Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Northern Air Temple
programme.desc: After hearing rumors about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Master
programme.desc: The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Meanwhile, Zhao plans an attack and Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North Part 1
programme.desc: The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao's Fire Navy fleet. In the heat of battle, Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn't a better way to use his Avatar abilities.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North Part 1

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North Part 2
programme.desc: Zhao's invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe's defenses, and he reveals a sinister plan.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North Part 2

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar State
programme.desc: Aang and the group meet an Earth Kingdom general who wants to use Aang's powerful "Avatar State" as a weapon to defeat the Fire Nation. But getting into the "Avatar state" on purpose is more difficult than Aang thinks.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Cave of Two Lovers
programme.desc: On their way to Omashu, the kids meet a group of nomads who show them a short cut through the 'cave of two lovers'.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Return to Omashu
programme.desc: The kids return to Omashu so that Aang can learn Earthbending from King Bumi. But when they get there, they are shocked to find the city is now in Fire Nation hands. Despite the danger, Aang enters Omashu in search of King Bumi.
